_meta.description: Curated, paraphrased statements reflecting public customer sentiment and feedback patterns across major OTT platforms in India.
_meta.methodology: Hand-compiled paraphrases of public review patterns, news coverage, and social discussions. Evaluated using VADER sentiment analysis.

netflix.text: The monthly subscription price is quite expensive compared to other streaming options in India.
Great library of international shows, high production value originals, and smooth recommendation algorithms.
Excellent 4K streaming performance with no buffering and reliable offline downloads on all devices.

jiohotstar.text: Unmatched live cricket and sports coverage, essential for following major tournaments and matches in India.
Disappointing to see ads shown even on paid premium plans during live matches and shows.
Occasional stream stuttering and server overload during high-traffic cricket finals.

prime_video.text: Great value bundle combined with Amazon Prime shopping delivery and Amazon Music benefits.
Frustrating introduction of ads in content unless paying an extra surcharge on top of prime membership.
The user interface can feel cluttered and mixes included content with rent or purchase titles.

youtube_premium.text: Completely ad-free YouTube experience across web and TV with background playback on mobile is fantastic.
Recent price hikes make the family plan significantly more costly than before.
Unbeatable infinite catalog of creator content, podcasts, tutorials, and YouTube Music included.
